sample_qc_notes.L3: Reassigned to H: E. coli/human LFQ sum ratio 1.958, matching H1/H2 (~1.9) rather than L1/L2/H3 (~0.6); raw intensity agrees.
sample_qc_notes.H3: Reassigned to L: E. coli/human LFQ sum ratio 0.631, matching L1/L2 rather than H1/H2; raw intensity agrees.
sample_qc_notes.L4: Excluded: identical to L1 in every row for LFQ, raw intensity, iBAQ, peptide and MS/MS-count columns (duplicate, not independent).
sample_qc_notes.H4: Excluded: 2504/6507 cleaned proteins have positive LFQ versus 4958-5648 in other samples; human median protein-centered LFQ is ~4 log2 below others. Severe run-quality/quantification failure.

intensity_columns_used: LFQ intensity L1, L2, H3 (condition L); LFQ intensity L3, H1, H2 (condition H); MaxQuant LFQ intensity columns, positive values only
filtering_rule: Flagged decoy/reverse, contaminant or only-identified-by-site rows removed; zero LFQ treated as missing; >=2 positive measurements in each of the reassigned L and H conditions; no peptide-count cutoff.
normalization_method: Log2 LFQ followed by per-sample additive offsets: median over human-annotated proteins detected in >=5 of 6 used samples of (log2 LFQ minus within-protein across-sample median); offsets median-centered and subtracted. Human protein amount is invariant by design.
imputation_method: None; available-case means and t tests on proteins observed in >=2 samples of each condition.
test_method: Independent two-sided pooled-variance Student t-test on normalized log2 LFQ H vs L, with available replicates (2-3 each); Benjamini-Hochberg across all tested protein groups, significant if adjusted p < 0.05.
processing_order: Inspect flagged hits, species ratios, detection, run outliers and duplicate profiles; remove three types of flagged rows; reassign L3 to H and H3 to L using E. coli/human ratios; exclude duplicate L4 and failed H4; set nonpositive LFQ missing, log2-transform; human-anchor normalize; retain >=2 observed in each condition; H-L sample means and two-sided pooled t test; BH adjustment and significance call.
